messages:
maya (partnerships): Heads up — Aerovault just sent their final asset pack for the marketplace tile + short case study. Need quick checks on: logos (SVG/EPS), partner-approved alt text, signed quote permission, marketplace thumbnail size (1200x628), hero image licensing, and JP/FR localized copy. Target publish Wed 3pm PT. Ping design/legal/marketing.

sam (design): Got it. I pulled the ZIP from the upload link they shared: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/abcdef
I mocked a 1200x628 tile and pushed a draft into the folder (aerovault_tile_draft_v1.png).
Quick asks: need vector EPS with clearspace guidelines and a white & dark SVG for hero overlays.

maya (partnerships): Quote they want to use: "Redwood's inference reduced batch latency by 3x" — legal ok with that wording?

omar (legal): Need signed permission for the quote and logo usage (partner must sign). Also confirm trademark form: should we use the brand lockup `Redwood Inference` or just `Redwood`? Alt text should avoid unverified claims. Suggested alt text: "Aerovault and Redwood Inference integration reduced inference latency in internal benchmarks." (can iterate)

priya (partnerships): I'll chase Aerovault for the permission form + a one-sentence customer attribution. ETA: EOD today.

sam (design): Small design note: their hero photo is 16:9 and gets noisy at 1200x628 center crop. Can they provide a 3:1 crop or a higher-res file? Also I added an alt text suggestion in the draft.

eli (product marketing): For the marketplace listing we need 3 bullets: throughput gains, latency improvement (up to X), and supported models. Jordan — can you confirm supported model names? Also we want a CTA link format like `/marketplace/aerovault?ref=redwood` (will add UTM later).

maya (partnerships): @deploy-bot uploaded their ZIP to the shared bucket just now.

deploy-bot: Upload complete: gs://redwood-partner-assets/aerovault/2026-03-21/aerovault-assets.zip

jordan (Aerovault): Thanks team! Confirmed: quote permission signed (uploaded `aerovault_quote_permission_2026-03-21.pdf`). We accept the suggested alt text change. We'll deliver EPS + white/dark SVGs and a 3:1 hero crop by EOD. Supported models: Llama2-70B, RW-v2-Base. JP/FR translations attached in the folder as `copy_jp.md` and `copy_fr.md`.

maya (partnerships): Great. Analytics asks we include UTM params. Priya, can you add?

priya (partnerships): Adding UTM params: 
```
utm_source=redwood&utm_medium=marketplace&utm_campaign=aerovault_launch
```
Will embed into the CTA.

omar (legal): I reviewed the signed permission doc. One legal ask: remove the absolute "3x" unless they want it public with benchmark link. Suggest wording: "up to 3x" and include internal eval link in the listing or an appendix. Jordan — can you provide the eval report link or agree to "up to 3x"?

jordan (Aerovault): We can go with "up to 3x" and we'll add a link to the internal eval report at launch. Uploading the eval PDF now.

maya (partnerships): Final checklist (tick off when done):
- EPS + white/dark SVG (jordan) ✅ incoming
- Hero 3:1 crop (jordan) ✅ incoming
- Signed quote permission (jordan) ✅ received
- Alt text updated (sam/maya) ✅ in draft
- Localized JP/FR copy (jordan) ✅ received
- Marketplace draft (sam) -> finalize after assets
- CTA + UTM (priya) -> done
Target publish Wed 3pm PT. Any blockers?

sam (design): No blockers on our side once we have EPS/SVG + hero crop.

eli (product marketing): I'll schedule the marketplace push and prepare release notes. Also want a short one-paragraph partner blog — Jordan, can you send a blurb?

jordan (Aerovault): Sending a one-paragraph blog blurb now: "Aerovault and Redwood Inference partnered to bring low-latency inference to large-scale multimodal workloads. By combining Aerovault's optimized inference stack with Redwood's serving runtime, customers see improved throughput and reduced tail latency."

maya (partnerships): Awesome — thanks everyone :rocket: I'll confirm once the publish is scheduled and post the final marketplace URL here.

(thumbs up reactions across thread)
